description: Add a Note to a Workspace: a few words of your own beside its Panels. Formatted text only, shown in Banquish's own style: "# Heading" (or "## Smaller heading"), paragraphs, "- " or "1. " list items, and [links](https://…); anything else, HTML included, shows as the text it is. At most 2000 characters. Placement is where its Tile goes on the grid, as in arrange; without one it goes full width below the last Tile. With h, a Note's Tile is that tall, even taller than its text. The user can undo it with the rest of your Working stretch. Returns the Fit report: at the user's window, which Tiles are scaled below their Panel's minimum width, have an h taller than their Panel (capped, with the h they got), scroll inside, fell back to crop, are broken or ambiguous, or leave their Tile's width unused, and any gaps between Tiles. A Tile whose page hasn't laid it out at its width yet (one not on screen, say) is settling: a later report says how it fits. While a settling Tile's minimum width isn't known, whether the Workspace shows as one column isn't either: oneColumn is left out, and the summary says so.
name: add_note
